storyCards.headline: The Lion Sleeps Tonight: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Tokens's "The Lion Sleeps Tonight" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.

The Lion Sleeps Tonight was released in 1961.

"The Lion Sleeps Tonight" by The Tokens.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
